name: Google Calendar
label: Google Calendar API v3
description: Google Calendar API v3 at https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api/v3/reference. Bearer access_token. listen is ingress. Never log tokens or event bodies.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Calendar official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"availability"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'availability', 'create_event', 'delete_event', 'get_event', 'list_events', 'update_event', 'list_calendars', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'availability'.

schema.label: timeMin
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `timeMin` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: timeMax
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `timeMax` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.description: Event.reminders {useDefault, overrides:[{method, minutes}]}. create_event / update_event. Example: {"useDefault":true}.

schema.description: Event.status. EXACT: confirmed | tentative | cancelled. create_event / update_event.

schema.label: Visibility
schema.description: Event.visibility. EXACT: default | public | private | confidential. create_event / update_event.

schema.label: Color id
schema.description: Event.colorId (1–11). create_event / update_event. Example: 7.

schema.label: Recurrence
schema.description: Event.recurrence RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE strings. create_event / update_event. Example: ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4"].

schema.label: Conference data
schema.description: Event.conferenceData (Meet). Set conferenceDataVersion=1 on the query. create_event / update_event.

schema.label: Guests can modify
schema.description: Event.guestsCanModify. create_event / update_event.

schema.label: Transparency
schema.description: Event.transparency. EXACT: opaque | transparent. create_event / update_event.

schema.label: Send updates
schema.description: Query sendUpdates for create/update/delete. EXACT: all | externalOnly | none.

schema.label: conferenceDataVersion
schema.description: Query conferenceDataVersion. Set 1 when sending conferenceData. create_event / update_event.

schema.label: Order by
schema.description: list_events orderBy. EXACT: startTime | updated. startTime requires singleEvents=true.

schema.label: Time zone
schema.description: IANA time zone for list_events / get_event / availability. Example: America/Chicago.

schema.label: Updated min
schema.description: list_events updatedMin RFC3339. Example: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

schema.label: Show deleted
schema.description: list_events showDeleted.

schema.label: Max attendees
schema.description: list_events / get_event maxAttendees.

schema.label: Calendar expansion max
schema.description: freeBusy calendarExpansionMax. availability. Max 50.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.
